TGO.note: The document states nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
Only a data collection for future models and envisaged uses; no government body is stated to use an AI system.
Health, justice and administration are named only as envisaged applications; no sector AI tool is stated piloted or in service.
It refers to a national AI strategy in passing but does not state its adoption, a body or funding.

facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports that Togo's ministry of public service efficiency and digital transformation, under minister Cina Lawson, officially launched in early October 2026 the three-year 'Voix du Togo' programme collecting voice and text data in Ewe, Kabiye and Moba (targets per language: 50 hours of validated audio, 6,000 translated sentence pairs, 500 speakers) to train AI models.

systems.owner: Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation, with Togo AI Lab
